## Sonilo V1.1 Music API

Sonilo V1.1 Music is a music generation model by Sonilo, available on the Venice API as `sonilo-v1-1-music`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Generate licensed, commercial-use-safe music with precise control over style, mood, instrumentation, and duration.

### Sonilo V1.1 Music API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sonilo-v1-1-music` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.1725 / min |

### Sonilo V1.1 Music specifications

| Spec | Value |

| Released | Jul 21, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |

### How to use the Sonilo V1.1 Music API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/queue` with `"model": "sonilo-v1-1-music"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "sonilo-v1-1-music",
    "prompt": "Warm lo-fi hip hop beat with soft piano and vinyl crackle",
    "duration_seconds": 30
  }'

# 2. Retrieve when ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "sonilo-v1-1-music", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output audio.mp3
```
